title: ghi-forecast-benchmark-6sites: Hour-ahead GHI forecasting benchmark scripts and per-site results for six humid tropical Indonesian stations
description:
Scripts and aggregate per-site results supporting the manuscript Hour-ahead irradiance forecasting in the humid tropics: model choice versus data sources at six Indonesian stations.

The package covers six BMKG climatological stations in Indonesia (Banten, Bengkulu, Jambi, Yogyakarta, West Kalimantan, Central Java; named by province), with harmonised 10-min data from 2022 to 2025 (train 2022–2023, validation 2024, test 2025). Version 2.0.0 contains the complete pipeline behind the manuscript: construction of the model frames from the harmonised database (Himawari-8/9 cloud product taken from the file 10 min before the origin, missing retrievals masked, cloud flag recomputed uniformly), Ineichen–Perez clear-sky irradiance and smart persistence, rule-based selection of 43 predictors from 104 candidates, eight machine-learning and deep-learning architectures at all six sites, a ridge-regression reference, source ablation of satellite cloud, SYNOP cloud and surface meteorology with daily-block bootstrap confidence intervals, multi-seed and hyperparameter-tuning checks, evaluation-protocol, target-definition and satellite-latency sensitivity analyses, a post-hoc decomposition of surface-meteorology subgroups, and the scripts that produce the manuscript and supplementary figures.

No observational data are included: raw and harmonised station data, DuckDB databases, model frames, clear-sky caches, prediction archives and trained models are withheld because of size and data-sharing policy. The harmonised BMKG station data are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request; Himawari-8/9 cloud products are available through the JAXA P-Tree system.
